mapper.select:
select max(trade_date) from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null
and trade_date <= #{endDate}
select from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by exchange asc, source asc
select from margin_account_stats where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by updated_at desc nulls last limit 1
select from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null and trade_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by trade_date asc, exchange asc, source asc

select from margin_stock_detail where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate}
and exchange = #{exchange}
and exists ( select 1 from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c where c.deleted_at is null and c.industry_code = #{industryCode} and c.stock_code = margin_stock_detail.stock_code and c.snapshot_date = coalesce( ( select max(c1.snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c1 where c1.deleted_at is null and c1.snapshot_date <= #{tradeDate} ), ( select max(c2.snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c2 where c2.deleted_at is null ) ) )
order by
stock_code
stock_name
exchange
financing_balance
financing_buy_amount
financing_repay_amount
securities_lending_balance
securities_lending_balance_amount
coalesce(margin_balance, coalesce(financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(securities_lending_balance_amount, 0))
asc nulls last desc nulls last
, stock_code asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: with snapshot_pick as ( select coalesce( ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null and snapshot_date <= #{tradeDate} ), ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null ) ) as snapshot_date ), constituents as ( select distinct c.snapshot_date, c.industry_code, c.stock_code from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c join snapshot_pick sp on sp.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date where c.deleted_at is null ), industry_mapping as ( select tdx_code6, tdx_name, ths_code, ths_name from ( select m.*, row_number() over ( partition by m.ths_code order by m.is_primary desc, m.priority asc, m.confidence desc ) as rn from tdx_ths_industry_mapping m where m.deleted_at is null ) ranked where rn = 1 ), ths_industry_names as ( select item ->> 'sectorCode' as ths_code, item ->> 'name' as ths_name from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h join snapshot_pick sp on h.snapshot_date = coalesce( ( select max(h1.snapshot_date) from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h1 where h1.deleted_at is null and h1.kind = 'industries' and h1.snapshot_date <= sp.snapshot_date ), ( select max(h2.snapshot_date) from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h2 where h2.deleted_at is null and h2.kind = 'industries' ) ) cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(h.payload -> 'items', '[]'::jsonb)) item where h.deleted_at is null and h.kind = 'industries' and item ->> 'sectorCode' is not null ), industry_agg as ( select #{tradeDate}::date as trade_date, c.snapshot_date as constituent_snapshot_date, c.industry_code, coalesce(max(im.ths_name), max(tn.ths_name), c.industry_code) as industry_name, max(im.tdx_code6) as tdx_code, max(im.tdx_name) as tdx_name, count(distinct c.stock_code)::int as constituent_count, count(distinct s.stock_code)::int as matched_stock_count, coalesce(sum(s.financing_balance), 0) as financing_balance, coalesce(sum(s.financing_buy_amount), 0) as financing_buy_amount, coalesce(sum(s.financing_repay_amount), 0) as financing_repay_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance), 0) as securities_lending_balance, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance_amount), 0) as securities_lending_balance_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_sell_volume), 0) as securities_lending_sell_volume, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_repay_volume), 0) as securities_lending_repay_volume, coalesce(sum(coalesce(s.margin_balance, coalesce(s.financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(s.securities_lending_balance_amount, 0))), 0) as margin_balance from constituents c left join industry_mapping im on im.ths_code = c.industry_code left join ths_industry_names tn on tn.ths_code = c.industry_code left join margin_stock_detail s on s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date = #{tradeDate} and s.stock_code = c.stock_code group by c.snapshot_date, c.industry_code )
mapper.select:
select trade_date, constituent_snapshot_date, industry_code, industry_name, tdx_code, tdx_name, constituent_count, matched_stock_count, financing_balance, financing_buy_amount, financing_repay_amount, securities_lending_balance, securities_lending_balance_amount, securities_lending_sell_volume, securities_lending_repay_volume, margin_balance from industry_agg order by
industry_code
industry_name
tdx_code
tdx_name
constituent_count
matched_stock_count
financing_balance
financing_buy_amount
financing_repay_amount
securities_lending_balance
securities_lending_balance_amount
margin_balance
asc nulls last desc nulls last
, industry_code asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
